reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis relies on an unsubstantiated claim that rapid heating–quenching of an HEA will produce microstructural heterogeneities that accelerate oxide film reformation compared to a duplex stainless steel, without specifying the HEA composition or explaining why the HEA's film dynamics would be superior, and it ignores the well-known excellent passivation of duplex stainless steels.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is detailed and includes in-situ monitoring and a clear falsification criterion, but the comparison is confounded by using a completely different baseline material (duplex stainless steel) instead of the same HEA without the treatment, making it impossible to isolate the effect of the proposed microstructural change.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it fails to address the core question of what governs the coupled tribo-corrosion response in HEAs, instead proposing a vague mechanism and an irrelevant comparison to a different alloy class.
